cli_result_text:
Submitted the relevant source files from both repositories:

**FastAPI (request validation chain):**
- `fastapi/dependencies/utils.py` — body parameter extraction, dependency injection, Pydantic validation of request bodies
- `fastapi/routing.py` — route handler wiring that invokes body parsing/validation
- `fastapi/_compat.py` — Pydantic v1/v2 compatibility shims (validation error formatting, field info)
- `fastapi/encoders.py` — `jsonable_encoder` used for response/model serialization
- `fastapi/exceptions.py` / `fastapi/exception_handlers.py` — 422 `RequestValidationError` construction
- `fastapi/openapi/models.py` — schema modeling used to describe expected body shape

**httpx (request encoding chain):**
- `httpx/_content.py` — JSON/body encoding logic (`encode_json`, content-length/type headers)
- `httpx/_models.py` — `Request`/`Response` construction, header handling
- `httpx/_client.py` — request building entry points (`request`, `post`, etc.)
- `httpx/_api.py` — top-level convenience functions
- `httpx/_types.py` — type aliases for request body/content params
- `httpx/_multipart.py` — multipart/form encoding (nested field handling)
